title: CustomerProfileOutput
description: Extensible JSON object from the selected workflow. Provider adapters validate their envelopes and identities. Optional display fields are extracted only when they are non-empty strings; other values remain in output.

card_id.description: Optional provider metadata; the separate response card_id is extracted only for a non-empty string.

nickname.description: Optional provider metadata; a non-empty customer.nickname may be promoted to this field.
